name: Exp_Heiken_Ashi_Smoothed
summary: This EA trades based on trend reversal signals from the Heiken Ashi Smoothed custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the trend changes from bearish to bullish and sell positions when the trend changes from bullish to bearish, with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于平滑均线修正K线（Heiken Ashi Smoothed）自定义指标的趋势反转信号进行交易。当趋势从空头转为多头时开多仓，从多头转为空头时开空仓，并支持可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Heiken Ashi Smoothed指标的趋势方向变化，通过读取指标缓冲区4的值来判断当前和前一根K线的趋势状态。入场条件为：当TrendValue从0变为1时产生做多信号并同时平空仓，当TrendValue从1变为0时产生做空信号并同时平多仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设定，以及反向趋势信号触发时的平仓操作。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数支持多种保证金计算模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金、固定手数）。资金管理方面提供了5种模式选择，默认使用固定手数（LOT）模式。该策略还包含了一个额外的趋势持续平仓逻辑：当允许同时开仓和平仓时，如果趋势信号持续，会重复发出平仓指令以确保仓位被正确关闭。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend direction changes from the Heiken Ashi Smoothed indicator, reading indicator buffer 4 to determine the current and previous bar's trend state. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when TrendValue changes from 0 to 1 (simultaneously closing sell positions), and a sell signal is generated when TrendValue changes from 1 to 0 (simultaneously closing buy positions). Exit conditions include hard stop-loss and take-profit levels, as well as position closure triggered by opposing trend signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio, while the MMMode parameter supports multiple margin calculation modes including free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management offers 5 modes with fixed lot (LOT) as the default. The strategy also includes an additional persistent-trend closing logic: when both open and close permissions are enabled for the same direction, repeated close signals are issued while the trend persists to ensure positions are properly closed.

parameters.description_en: Smoothing phase (JJMA:-100~+100, VIDYA:CMO period, AMA:fast EMA period)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于趋势反转信号交易，易于理解和维护
支持10种平滑算法选择，用户可根据市场特性灵活调整指标参数
止损止盈设置合理（1:2风险收益比），且包含滑点控制参数
提供5种仓位管理模式，适应不同风险偏好的交易者
包含新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic based on trend reversal signals, easy to understand and maintain
Supports 10 smoothing algorithms, allowing flexible indicator parameter tuning for different market conditions
Reasonable stop-loss/take-profit setup (1:2 risk-reward ratio) with slippage control parameter
Offers 5 position sizing modes to accommodate traders with different risk preferences
Includes new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated entries within the same bar
cons: 缺少市场波动性过滤（如ATR），在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
止损1000点和止盈2000点的固定值偏大，未根据市场波动率动态调整，可能不适合所有品种
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
依赖外部自定义指标和TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，移植性较差
SignalBar默认为1意味着信号有延迟，但缺少实时信号（SignalBar=0）时的额外过滤保护
cons_en: Lacks volatility filtering (e.g., ATR), prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are large and not dynamically adjusted for market volatility, may not suit all instruments
No existing position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Depends on external custom indicator and TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, reducing portability
SignalBar defaults to 1 introducing signal delay, but lacks additional filtering protection when using real-time signals (SignalBar=0)
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈功能，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离
添加持仓检查和最大持仓数量限制，防止同方向重复开仓导致过度暴露
增加震荡/趋势市场过滤器（如ADX或布林带宽度），在震荡市中减少交易频率
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that automatically adjusts distances based on market volatility
Add position check and maximum position count limit to prevent duplicate same-direction entries causing overexposure
Add a ranging/trending market filter (e.g., ADX or Bollinger Band width) to reduce trade frequency in sideways markets

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查，可能同方向重复开仓导致仓位过大
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，在低波动市场中止损过大而在高波动市场中止损过小
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中会频繁触发假信号造成连续亏损
risk_points_en: No position check may lead to duplicate same-direction entries causing oversized positions
Fixed stop-loss/take-profit ignores market volatility, being too wide in low-volatility and too tight in high-volatility markets
Trend-following strategy generates frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
